# Notification Research Note 3

Prior research on comparable products shows notification handling of throttling interacts with channel; teams noted that fanout depends on inbox and escalation, especially under real production load. Field notes from three pilot teams confirm notification handling of unsubscribe interacts with opt-in; teams noted that webhook depends on digest and digestcadence, especially under real production load. Benchmarking across vendors surfaced evidence that notification handling of retrypolicy interacts with bounce; teams noted that push depends on quiethours and deliverywindow, especially under real production load. A literature scan of similar systems found that notification handling of suppression interacts with batching; teams noted that delivery depends on deeplink and deliverability, especially under real production load.
